units.box: C++ random-mode box, side L = 1000^(1/d) = 31.622776601683793 (D-004: stale num = 1000), V = 1000.0, density N/V = 0.256; use xla Box(basis = L I) and Cartesian dynamics in it
units.K: K = Ka / a, a = (phi_fake / V_d(1))^(1/d) (main.cpp:172, :242) = xla_cco.kvectors.k_outer_from_ka (bit-equal); same K in the same box
units.phi: C++ Energy = sum_{half-space k, w = 1} |rho_k|^2 / V + Shift, Shift = 0, soft core off (val = 0) = xla StealthyEnergy; no per-particle normalisation. phi_cpp: harness %.17g; phi_log: 6 digits (D-052)
units.ke: KE = sum_i m |v_i|^2 / 2, m = 1 (MD_System.cpp:375); <KE> = N d T / 2 (no COM removal); 6 digits only
units.T: kT = T directly (SetRandomSpeed sigma = sqrt(kT / m))

protocol.dt_source: main.cpp:378 MDTimeStep = 0.01, fixed (random mode passes MDAutoTimeStep = false)
protocol.prerelax: RelaxStructure_NLOPT (L-BFGS, 1000 evaluations) from a uniform random config; velocities start at 0 and the first half-kick uses a zero acceleration (D-051)
protocol.stage1_equilibration: Nc_equi times: 2 x [SetRandomSpeed(T): every component of every v_i ~ N(0, T), no COM removal; NVE Evolve(50000)]
protocol.stage2_sample: Nc times: AndersonEvolve(50000, T, p = 0.01), then NVE Evolve(50000); then log Phi, KE and save positions
protocol.integrator: velocity Verlet: v += dt a / 2; r += dt v; a = F(r); v += dt a / 2 (MD_System.cpp:128-166); Andersen resets follow the step

andersen.rule: per call ResetCount = 0.0; after each full Verlet step ResetCount += p; while ResetCount > 0: one particle i = floor(U N) (with replacement) gets v_i ~ N(0, T/m) per component (Box-Muller sin branch), ResetCount -= 1 (MD_System.cpp:199-250)
andersen.note: fires on step 1; the float sum of 0.01 puts the 2nd reset at step 100, then every 100 steps (D-050)

protocol.com: never removed: SetRandomSpeed and Andersen draw all N d components independently, so the COM momentum fluctuates and KE counts N d degrees of freedom
protocol.rng: one RandomGenerator(seed) (rngGod) drives the initial config, the velocities and the Andersen draws

unit_gate.compared: xla StealthyEnergy vs C++ ShiftedCCPotential (harness) on every sampled ConfigPack configuration
